name: cold14-h4a
title: PR622's K-triangle words with ColdThird's h4a cold ends, at a free dispatch (jp8 x71, ck x1) with an exact per-time-Hall owner map (exact-window MIP, RINS, warm-started from PR626's map)
summary: Provider menu {ck, jp8} of h4a words (PR622 K-triangle chains; cold_end recipes from ColdThird). Owner search with Stack492's solve_h.py (helper ranges from the word R; objective sum F(r) = r*(73/r)^b, b = 0.001635) on the h4a provider locals (ColdThird runs/D1): (1) aggregate free-dispatch LP (crossover, tight 3) warm-started from PR626's map -> LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json; (2) dispatch = per-time argmax of the LP selections -> DISPATCH.json (jp8 x71, ck x1 at time 5); (3) exact-window LP (crossover) over base + AGG patterns with weight >= 0.01 -> LP-PATTERNS-EX.json; (4) exact-window MIP, RINS around the EX vertex (slack 2/1), gap 1e-9, 2 threads, 150 s, warm-started from PR626's map (64 narrowing, 8 widening calls): time limit, obj 523258.596002, bound 523258.553908, gap 8.04e-8; (5) mkplan.py --locals (ColdThird runs/D1 locals) reproduces data/PLAN.json byte for byte. The map is admitted by the package's verifier chain, not by the search.

dispatch.origin: at the free dispatch jp8 ×71, ck ×1 (per-time argmax of the aggregate free-dispatch hosting LP over the h4a words {ck, jp8})
dispatch.plan_rule: the window MIP's PLAN with the provider registry re-derived from the admitted provider locals (widths over the word's R helpers) and `profile`/`assignment_sha256` recomputed from the map (Stack492 mkplan.py)

owners.origin: an exact per-time-Hall exact-window MIP solution (RINS around the exact-window LP vertex; 150 s time limit, relative gap 8.04e-8), warm-started from PR626's map
owners.warm_owners_origin: PR626's `data/OWNERS.json.gz` (complex-k492-owner-repair), the warm start of the aggregate LP and the MIP

search.tool: solve_h.py (Stack492's copy: helper ranges from the word R)
search.dispatch_rule: per time t: argmax over providers of LP-PATTERNS-AGG selections[t]

lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json: aggregate free-dispatch LP relaxation over the h4a words {ck, jp8} (crossover, tight 3), warm-started from PR626's map
lp_inputs.DISPATCH.json: the dispatch {time: provider} = per-time argmax of the aggregate LP selections (ck at time 5)
lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-EX.json: exact-window LP relaxation (crossover) at that dispatch over the base patterns plus aggregate-LP patterns with weight >= 0.01
lp_inputs.TEMPLATE-PLAN.json: the PLAN whose windows/order/registry template the nominator reuses (same as PR622's)
